name: A-Tech Solution Co., Ltd.
summary: A-Tech Solution Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of injection-molded goods. Its diverse product range encompasses highly precise and large-scale injection molds, alongside precision and substantial press dies. The company also manufactures accurate gear molds, various automotive parts, and components for light-emitting diode lead frames. Established on August 20, 2001, its operations are based in Hwaseong-si, South Korea.
